title: midi-player
description: `midi-player` is a MIDI file player and analyzer based on `mrpeach/midifile`; it filters out non-note information and outputs notes in Pd style, along with file timing information, flushed note data, and an end-of-file bang. Use messages such as `read`, `play`, `loop`, and `quantize` to load and control playback, and `flush` or `panic` to send all notes off through the second outlet.
